name: Perimeter Watch
description: External security audit of your WAN: what Shodan observes open on your IP (compared against what you intend, including honeypot and canary traps), plus CrowdSec CTI reputation. Keyless.

settings.label: Expected (intentionally open) ports
settings.help: Everything you open ON PURPOSE: your services AND your deception ports. The default is the stock TuxWall set - honeypot (23, 445, 2323, 3389, 5555), canary (22, 5900, 1433, 6379, 161), and the dashboard (443). Anything Shodan observes outside this list raises a critical incident.

settings.label: Additional IPs to check
settings.help: Optional comma-separated list (e.g. a VPS you own).

settings.label: Check CrowdSec reputation (CTI)
settings.help: Reports whether your IP is listed as an attacker in CrowdSec threat intel. Keyless; shows as unreachable if your DNS blocks cti.crowdsec.net.
